correctness.rationale: Appending zero creates at most one new occurrence and creates it exactly at the residue r modulo M. Two progression color sequences first differ at the minimum trigger t; equality of their first mismatches is equivalent to seeing a 1 earlier than t. A linear congruence provides a bounded finite window. Constant multiplication and pattern parity are finite transducers, giving 2-automaticity. The extracted stdlib checker corroborates 9,063 finite progression cases and 29,184 append identities.
